instruction: Place the stapler with smooth plastic body on the rectangular displaystand with the left arm.

source.instruction: Place the stapler with smooth plastic body on the rectangular displaystand with the left arm.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the object, which was at x = -27 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm above the red stapler at (-27, -2) and orient gripper downwards.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+3, +17, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-27, -3, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-27, -3, 84) opening 0.23; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-5, -11, 89) opening 0.22; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
